mathematical_definition: tick_volume / (spread + 1.0) -- pointwise ratio of tick activity to quoted spread (no rolling window)
numerical_stability_notes: live_compatible=false: this feature needs BOTH tick_volume (available live per-bar) and spread (NOT available as per-bar history live -- MarketState's bounded buffer only holds the current live tick's instantaneous spread plus Task 21's tick-level ring buffers). It inherits the spread limitation from spread_change_1/spread_percentile_252/spread_volatility_60, so it is marked live_compatible=false even though its tick_volume half alone would be live-computable. Task 21's live-tick spread family replaces the spread side for live use (spec section 7). +1.0 denominator offset avoids division by zero when spread==0.
missing_value_policy: No rolling-window NaNs (pointwise ratio); NaN only wherever tick_volume or spread themselves are NaN (e.g. missing source rows), never zero-filled
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.156 (<0.3), MI rank 31 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.156, cv_importance=0.816, mi_rank=31, family=H_microstructure.
